violations.description: Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed using same pair of single-use gloves for more than one task. Observed food employee adjusting her clothing with gloved hands and did not change them before continuing food prep. Gloves should be changed when touching items not related to food preparation.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Floor tiles were found missing near the back door of the kitchen. Floors should be maintained in good repair.

General premises. — --Perimeter walls and roof did not effectively protect establishment from the weather and entry of insects, rodents, and other animals. Large gap found between the bottom of the back door and the floor. Gaps in doorways should be minimized to prevent the entrance of insects, rodents and other animals.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Pan found under the handwashing sink drain for catching drips and leaks. Also, observed water sitting on the floor along the wall between the hand sink and 3 compartment sink. Plumbing should be properly maintained.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Wall with the hand washing sink and 3 compartment sink was found buckled just above the tile baseboards. Multiple tiles also found missing along the baseboard throughout the kitchen.
